skills.name: PoC script skeleton
skills.description: Start every exploit PoC from a safe template.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Write the skeleton with file.write: docstring, argparse (target, --dry-run, --consent), logging.
2. Default to dry-run: no network action without explicit flags.
3. Centralize request sending in one function with try/except.
4. Log request/response pairs to a run log file.
5. Test the skeleton runs with python.run_file --help.

skills.name: Raw HTTP request crafting
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Use requests or raw sockets deliberately (python.run_file).
2. Control every header; document unusual ones.
3. Handle redirects and cookies explicitly.
4. Verify against http.capture ground truth.
5. Keep a request-recipe note file.

skills.name: Payload encoding toolkit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Implement URL/base64/hex/unicode escapes with python.run_file.
2. Encode on demand, never double-encode blindly.
3. Round-trip test each encoder.
4. Wire the encoder into your PoC CLI.
5. Document per-context choices.

skills.name: Response diffing engine
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Fetch baseline and probe responses in python.run_file.
2. Normalize (whitespace, dynamic tokens) before compare.
3. Diff with difflib; report similarity score.
4. Calibrate against known-true and known-false probes.
5. Persist the diff tool for reuse.

skills.name: Blind extraction automation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Implement the oracle check function (boolean or timing).
2. Binary-search character sets in python.run_file.
3. Throttle: small sleep, capped requests.
4. Checkpoint progress to a file for resume.
5. Stop at defined length or confidence.

skills.name: Timing oracle utilities
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect N baseline samples in python.run_file.
2. Compute mean/stdev; define the threshold.
3. Validate the oracle with known-true/false conditions.
4. Only then run the real extraction.
5. Report measurement statistics.

skills.name: Exploit chain composition
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Model each stage as a function returning state.
2. Pass state explicitly between stages.
3. Abort cleanly on any stage failure.
4. Log the full chain trace.
5. Test stages individually first.

skills.name: Request fuzzer writing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define a grammar of mutable fields in python.run_file.
2. Generate mutations: swap, encode, boundary values.
3. Send with strict rate limiting.
4. Cluster responses by signature.
5. Save interesting mutations for review.

skills.name: Wordlist generation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Derive candidates from the target's language/brand (http.history terms).
2. Combine with generic lists via python.run_file.
3. Dedupe and case-normalize.
4. Size-cap for politeness.
5. Save with file.write.

skills.name: Scanner output aggregation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Parse web.sqlmap/xssscan/dirbrute outputs with python.run_file.
2. Normalize to one JSON schema.
3. Merge by (host, param, type).
4. Rank by severity.
5. file.write the combined report.

skills.name: Automated report generation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Read the findings JSON (file.read).
2. Render markdown with sections per finding via python.run_file.
3. Include evidence file references.
4. Redact secrets automatically.
5. Output the final report path.

skills.name: Polite HTTP client pooling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Implement a token-bucket rate limiter in python.run_file.
2. Pool connections per host.
3. Honor Retry-After headers.
4. Cap total requests per run.
5. Log rate stats.

skills.name: Target config loading
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define a JSON target file: hosts, scope, auth notes (no secrets inline).
2. Validate with python.run_file.
3. Refuse to run when scope is missing.
4. Log the loaded scope at start.
5. Keep per-engagement configs separate.

skills.name: Authenticated session helper
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Implement login -> cookie/token capture in python.run_file.
2. Refresh on 401 transparently.
3. Never log credentials or tokens.
4. Verify session validity with a harmless request.
5. Store session state in memory only.

skills.name: Unicode-safe payload handling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Normalize payloads to NFC in python.run_file.
2. Round-trip via the transport encoding.
3. Verify server-side interpretation via reflection.
4. Keep byte-level logs when needed.
5. Document gotchas.

skills.name: Proxy-aware PoC design
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Support HTTP(S)_PROXY env or flag in python.run_file.
2. Verify the proxy path with a canary request.
3. Capture through http.capture when needed.
4. Compare direct vs proxied behavior.
5. Document the setup.

skills.name: Retry with backoff
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Implement exponential backoff with jitter in python.run_file.
2. Cap retries; fail loudly after.
3. Never retry non-idempotent destructive calls.
4. Log each retry with reason.
5. Summarize retry stats.

skills.name: Safe CLI defaults
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Require --target plus --consent to act.
2. Default --dry-run true.
3. Print the plan before acting when dry-run.
4. Exit non-zero on refused actions.
5. Test all flag paths with python.run_file.

skills.name: Run artifact management
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Create a run folder per execution (file.write).
2. Save requests, responses, and a timeline.
3. Hash artifacts at end.
4. Reference the folder in reports.
5. Clean old runs on request.

skills.name: Double-verification rule
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Reproduce with two independent methods (tool + custom script).
2. Compare evidence.
3. Only report when both agree.
4. Note the verification method in the report.
5. Keep both evidence sets.

skills.name: Idempotent exploitation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Detect prior exploitation markers before acting.
2. Skip completed stages.
3. Summarize state at start.
4. Enable safe resume after interruption.
5. Test resume behavior.

skills.name: Session state snapshots
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Persist cookies/tokens hashes (not values) to a state file.
2. Reload state on resume in python.run_file.
3. Verify state validity on load.
4. Rotate snapshots per run.
5. Keep values out of logs.

skills.name: Error oracle design
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Catalog error signatures from probes (http.replay).
2. Map signature -> meaning in a table (python.run_file).
3. Use the oracle in extraction flows.
4. Watch for WAF-injected fake errors.
5. Document the catalog.

skills.name: Rate-limit aware automation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Watch for 429/throttle patterns in python.run_file loops.
2. Back off immediately on signal.
3. Persist progress before backing off.
4. Resume politely after the window.
5. Report limit observations.

skills.name: Payload minimization
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Start minimal; add only on failure.
2. Verify each addition changes behavior.
3. Keep a minimal-vs-full comparison log.
4. Prefer readable payloads for reports.
5. Document the minimal set.

skills.name: Multi-target orchestration
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Load the scoped target list (target config).
2. Serialize per-host work; cap global concurrency in python.run_file.
3. Aggregate per-host summaries.
4. Preserve per-host evidence folders.
5. Produce a combined matrix.

skills.name: PoC environment isolation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Prefer running PoCs in an isolated container/VM.
2. Document the isolation boundary (file.write).
3. Verify no host mounts are writable.
4. Monitor egress during runs (tcpdump.capture).
5. Record the setup in engagement notes.

skills.name: Visual evidence capture
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Reproduce in web.browser; capture via web.browser screenshot action.
2. Name files by finding id.
3. Reference them in the report.
4. Keep images free of sensitive data.
5. Verify the image shows the claimed state.

skills.name: Traffic signature normalization
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Extract stable signatures (method+path+param) in python.run_file.
2. Cluster responses by signature+status.
3. Drop redundant hits.
4. Report unique findings only.
5. Keep the raw set archived.

skills.name: Bounty reproduction pack
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Assemble: summary, steps, PoC, impact, environment.
2. Include sanitized evidence files.
3. Verify the PoC runs from a clean state.
4. Remove anything out-of-scope per program policy.
5. file.write the pack manifest.

skills.name: Command output parsing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Read raw outputs with file.read.
2. Write parsers per tool with python.run_file (regex/line state).
3. Round-trip test on saved samples.
4. Normalize to JSON.
5. Wire parsers into the aggregator.

skills.name: Check template authoring
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define metadata: id, severity, matchers.
2. Implement matchers against captured responses (python.run_file).
3. Test true and false positives.
4. Version the template file.
5. Share within your notes library.

skills.name: Standard exploit logging
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Structured lines: ts, stage, request id, outcome.
2. One file per run (file.write).
3. Never log secrets.
4. Rotate per session.
5. Summarize at end.

skills.name: Payload dictionary management
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Maintain per-class payload files (SSTI, SQLi, XSS) with file.write.
2. Version and date them.
3. Prune after filter learnings.
4. Load them in PoCs via CLI flag.
5. Review quarterly.

skills.name: API recon scripting
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Crawl docs/specs (web.crawl).
2. Enumerate endpoints from OpenAPI if present via python.run_file.
3. Probe each with harmless methods.
4. Record auth requirements.
5. file.write the endpoint inventory.

skills.name: Response header intelligence
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect headers across endpoints (http.capture).
2. Parse server/x-powered-by/cookies with python.run_file.
3. Map to stack hypotheses.
4. Verify with behavior probes.
5. Record in engagement notes.

skills.name: Custom scanner pipeline
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define stages: recon, enumerate, probe, verify.
2. Implement stage runner in python.run_file.
3. Pass state via files between stages.
4. Keep each stage restartable.
5. Report pipeline stats.

skills.name: PoC code review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the whole script.
2. Check: input validation, error paths, logging.
3. Confirm safe defaults.
4. Test dry-run first.
5. Approve only after a lab run.

skills.name: Exploit regression suite
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Maintain a lab target per PoC (workspace notes).
2. Run the suite after lab updates via python.run_file.
3. Flag broken PoCs for fixing.
4. Track pass rate over time.
5. Save the trend.

skills.name: Network safety defaults
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Default to single-host runs.
2. Require explicit flag for ranges.
3. Cap ports/paths per run.
4. Log scope at start.
5. Refuse unscoped ranges in helpers.

skills.name: WAF-aware probing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Fingerprint the WAF from response diffs (python.run_file).
2. Slow probes below threshold.
3. Rotate benign encodings where needed.
4. Stop on block patterns.
5. Record WAF behavior.

skills.name: Data minimization in PoCs
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Extract minimal proof (row 1, one file head).
2. Never bulk-dump on production.
3. Summarize what full access would mean.
4. Redact any real data shown.
5. State the boundary in the report.

skills.name: Exploit cleanup discipline
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List artifacts created (accounts, files) during the run.
2. Remove them via documented reverse steps.
3. Verify removal.
4. Record cleanup in the report.
5. Confirm with the owner when unsure.

skills.name: PoC README standards
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Write README with file.write: purpose, usage, safety, author, license.
2. Include example safe invocation.
3. State supported versions.
4. Link the advisory/CVE.
5. Review with cat_exp_poc_code_review flow.

skills.name: Second-order effect checks
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Submit payloads; then re-fetch affected stored views later (http.replay).
2. Correlate render-time execution.
3. Automate the wait-and-check loop with python.run_file.
4. Document the delay pattern.
5. Report second-order findings.
